round: V30: more stage-2 residual training via parallel (Hogwild) TD, then a whole-game evaluation
status: frozen before training and before any outcome of this round
motivation: V29: the five-cell residual raised first-3072 -> 6144 from 44.8% to 58.1% and its curve was still rising at 3e9 moves. Single-thread training runs ~0.2M moves/s; a 16-thread lock-free trainer measured 1.52M moves/s (pilot, 7.2x).
residual: as V29 (model5.h): four five-cell patterns x 8 symmetries on stage 2, zero initialised, trained jointly with the four-cell stage-2 table

training.rateSteps: 50% and 85% of each arm's move budget (global move count)
training.nondeterminism: lock-free shared updates are not bit-reproducible; model hashes are recorded after training and before evaluation
training.pilot: throughput only, 1e7 moves per thread, seed 99300001: 1/6/12/16 threads = 0.21/0.82/1.33/1.52 M moves/s; pilot models discarded unevaluated

S.what: same budget and rate schedule as V29 R, but 16 threads: checks whether Hogwild training loses quality

select.pool: training/v29-five/pools/curve3072.txt (1024 first-3072 states, already used in V29 for descriptive curves)
select.search: website default (depth 5, cutoff 0.01, clamp), to first 6144 or death; V29R and CUR reuse their V29 curve results
select.rule: winner = candidate with most 6144s; ties go to the more-trained candidate (list order). Descriptive only, no test.

arms.W: the selected candidate: its four-stage file (stages 0,1,3 verified identical to CUR) plus its stage-2 residual

games.search: website default: depth 5, cutoff 0.01, clamp, complete depth every move (no node or time cap), standard nine-card openings to 12288 or death (training/v30-parallel/game.cpp)
games.multiplicity: Holm across P1-P3 (as V24). No interim analysis.
games.secondary: 1536/3072 rates, Wilson intervals, CPU ms per move (16 concurrent processes), max move CPU, incomplete-depth moves
games.power: V29 suggests ~39% -> ~50% for 6144; 2048 pairs detect a few percentage points with high power

adoption: No website change in V30. A website release of the residual needs its own size/format design and browser parity and timing checks.
compile: c++ -std=c++17 -O3 -pthread training/v30-parallel/train.cpp -o training/v30-parallel/bin/train; c++ -std=c++17 -O3 training/v30-parallel/game.cpp -o training/v30-parallel/bin/game; training/v29-five/bin/tools as in V29
parity: before freezing: game.cpp with no residual reproduced the first two V24 NEW games field-for-field (non-timing)
